properties.statement: Wrote an offline replica of the blast-radius traversal and ran it over every node of a committed export. The goal was the distribution of region sizes (median, p90, max) at depth 1 and 2 for a population of nodes, plus how often two random regions overlap and how often one agent's edit target falls inside another's region. propagate_from answers one seed at a time, so this took a replica, checked against the live server on a handful of seeds, rather than thousands of calls.
